items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: Yes, I know Lowell. Lowell, he's one of those Okies.

ctx.x: Yes, I know Lowell. Lowell, he's one of those Okies. Yes. And he can sing the blues, too. Yes, he does a good job of the blues, you know, and of course,

as you say, I think there's been a lot of guys that -- musicians even that are -- you know, mix with Indians in Texas, out of Oklahoma, you know what I mean. But then too, you see, there was a lot of people that wouldn't dare say what they were, you know what I mean. They hid behind the curtain for a long time. There was a whole lot of people. A lot of people changed their names, you know what I mean?
